sample.headline: Under 1.5 shots rides the Book's price, not a real projection gap
sample.reason: This one is about the Book's price more than the Bot's number: the Bot projects Devon Toews for 1.46 shots, a hair under 1.5, and only 50.48% of his weighted games landed on the under at this line. The push down comes from less power-play time lately, worth -1.8, and the fit's league-wide scaling at -1.6, while the game script with COL expected to score 3.3 adds 2.4 back. What the projection leaves out is his recent form of 1.77 over his last 5 games, which the fit does not weigh at all. The Book's no-vig chance on the under is 53.06%, and the desk bets 53.3% against a 51.22% break-even, so the 2.08-point edge comes mostly from the Book's own pricing, on a prop type the desk leans only halfway on. Also, the desk is 94-106 on this type and side across 200 graded bets.
sample.risk: He has averaged 1.77 shots over his last 5 games, form the Bot gives no weight, and with the projection only 0.04 under the line, two shots on one active night cashes the over.
